correctness.rationale: The different-exponent computation yields genus 8 and divisor valuations; the eight monomials are independent and span the holomorphic differentials. Cartier extraction from y=y^3−f gives exactly four nonzero images. Two fixed images contribute rank 2; the residual 2×2 determinant is (λ−ab)^(1/3). Its first column is nonzero, so rank is 4 off ab=λ and 3 on it. A second Cartier application kills the residual plane, proving rank 2 for every higher iterate. The finite GF9 verification agrees in 3888 instances but does not prove the infinite-field theorem.
